title: HB 3 (2005-2006 (126th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 3: Election reforms
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a current and valid photo identification, a military identification that shows the voter's name and current address, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of an election mailed by a board of elections under section 3501.19 of the Revised Code or a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and current address of the elector.
(section) 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) If the elector provides either a driver's license or a state identification card issued under section 4507.50 of the Revised Code that does not contain the elector's current residence address, the elector shall provide the last four digits of the elector's driver's license number or state identification card number
(section) 3501.01(AA)
(quote) (3) It shows a photograph of the individual to whom it was issued. (4) It includes an expiration date that has not passed. (5) It was issued by the government of the United States or this state.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) the elector may provide the last four digits of the elector's social security number. Upon providing the social security number information, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code, the envelope of which ballot shall include that social security number information.
(section) 3505.18(A)(4)
(quote) the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification that the elector cannot provide the identification required under that division or the last four digits of the elector's social security number for those reasons. Upon signing the affirmation, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) 3505.181(B)(4)
(quote) If the appropriate local election official to whom the ballot or voter or address information is transmitted under division (B)(3) of this section determines that the individual is eligible to vote, the individual's provisional ballot shall be counted as a vote in that election.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) 3509.03(E)
(quote) (E) One of the following: (1) The elector's driver's license number; (2) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (3) A copy of the elector's current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification that shows the elector's name and current address, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document
(section) 3509.05(A)
(quote) If the elector does not provide the elector's driver's license number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope, the elector also shall include in the return envelope with the identification envelope a copy of the elector's current valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification that shows the elector's name and current address, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) 3503.14(A)(5)
(quote) (5) The voter to provide one or more of the following: (a) The voter's driver's license number, if any; (b) The last four digits of the voter's social security number, if any; (c) A copy of a current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification that shows the voter's name and current address, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document
(section) 3503.15(C)(4)
(quote) A search program capable of verifying registered voters and their registration information by name, driver's license number, birth date, social security number, or current address;
(other) 109.95: Attorney General may start criminal proceedings for election fraud
(other) 3501.19 (new, sunsets 1 Jan 2009) and 3501.05, 3501.10, 3501.11: election notices and Secretary of State duties
(other) 3503.x (3503.02-.24) and 3503.15, 3503.28, 3503.29: voter registration changes; statewide voter registration database required by the Help America Vote Act; voter information notices
(other) 3505.18-3505.183: ID at the polls (this bill's main ID rule) and provisional ballot rules including a ten-day follow-up window
(other) 3506.x (3506.01-.23): voting equipment, optical scan counting standards
(other) 3509.x, 3511.x: absentee and armed-service absentee voting
(other) 3513.x, 3519.x: primaries, nominating and initiative petitions
(other) 3515.x: recounts (a requester pays the full cost if the result does not change)
(other) 3517.x, 3599.x: campaign finance and election crimes
(other) Many local-government sections (131.23, 303.12, 511.28, 5705.x and others): ballot-issue procedures and notice (read from the title only)
(other) version: 00_IN: narrow ID rule only. 3505.18(A)(2)(a)/(b): a first-time voter who registered by mail must show current valid photo ID or a utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document with name and address; no ID means a provisional ballot. No ID text for absentee ballots. No SSN or affirmation fallback.
(other) version: 01_IC (Sub. HB 3, as reported by House committee): 3505.18(A)(2) limits the ID rule to a person who has not voted before in Ohio and registered by mail without giving an SSN-4, driver's license number or ID copy; no ID means a provisional ballot. Adds ID options to the registration form (3503.14) and to the absentee application and envelope (3509.03/3509.05).
(other) version: 02_RH: same ID design as 01_IC (first-time mail registrants only; absentee ID text present).
(other) version: 03_PH (as passed by House): same as 02_RH.
(other) version: 04_RS (Senate Rules committee substitute): ID rule extended to every elector who votes in person: current and valid photo ID or utility bill etc.; SSN-4 then provisional ballot; affirmation for a voter with no SSN; provisional ballot if the voter declines. Absentee-ballot ID text (3509.03/3509.05) not carried.
(other) version: 05_PS (as passed by Senate): same universal in-person ID rule as 04_RS; adds driver's license/state ID with an old address (last four digits of the number) and excludes election or registration notices mailed by the board as proof of address. Absentee-ballot ID text still not carried.
(other) version: 06_CR (committee of conference): universal in-person ID kept; adds a military identification showing name and current address; absentee application/envelope ID text and registration-form ID options restored.
(other) version: 07_EN (enrolled Am. Sub. HB 3): same ID text as 06_CR; adds the 3501.01(AA) definition of photo identification, 3503.15 database search, and 3505.181-.183 provisional ballot rules.
(other) note: Quotes are from 07_EN (enrolled, Am. Sub. HB 3). Struck words are not marked in these PDF texts. Where the enrolled text has leftover struck words at the start of a sentence (for example 'he, the elector shall announce his to...'), the quote starts after them. The 00_IN version is only 3505.18, 3505.181, 3506.21 and a few others; later versions are large omnibus election bills. Version differences were read from section 3505.18 and by counting ID terms in each version.
